packageRules.description: golangci-lint-action's version input takes a tag, not a digest: pinning it failed the whole github-actions group with update failure

Cooldown before automerge picks up a release: a hijacked package is usually spotted and yanked within days. digest is in here because a digest-only update means an upstream tag moved onto another commit. vulnerabilityAlerts overrides this, so CVE fixes still land at once
Docker digests carry no release timestamp: under the default timestamp-required, minimumReleaseAge held them forever
Automerge all safe updates (minor/patch/digest) via PR once CI passes
Minor Go module bumps ship in the binary -> cut a minor release
Patch/digest Go module bumps ship in the binary -> cut a patch release
Actions do not ship in the binary -> no release. github-runners is a datasource rather than a manager, so the github-actions manager carries the runner labels too

Go toolchain updates. Both depTypes are needed: golang is the go directive, which Renovate leaves alone unless rangeStrategy bump unlocks it, toolchain is the toolchain directive, which it bumps by default
Kubernetes modules share a v0.x release train and must move in lockstep; batch them into one PR

customManagers.description: Tools pinned as plain env vars in the workflows (svu, goimports), which no built-in manager sees
